action_items: None — iteration 13 backend criteria fully satisfied. Frontend `rewriteMedia()` in /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts correctly maps every /api/media/… response field to an absolute URL prefixed with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (verified via code review, not runtime since request was backend-only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1487 SAMPLE_VIDEOS now uses ExoPlayer/samplelib/test-videos.co.uk hosts only — no Pexels, no commondatastorage. Note: 'storage.googleapis.com/exoplayer-test-media-0/...' is a DIFFERENT bucket from the previously-flagged 'commondatastorage.googleapis.com' and is known-good for mobile.

backend/migrations/dedup_base64_media.py — decode_and_save() uses uuid4().hex + safe extension whitelist (jpg/png/webp/gif/svg/mp4/webm/mov) with 'jpg' fallback. No path traversal risk. It correctly rewrites deals.image_url/video_url and merchants.logo/cover_image using $regex match on '^data:' — matches exactly base64 URIs.
backend/migrations/dedup_base64_media.py:80 swap_pexels_videos uses round-robin over RELIABLE_VIDEOS[4] — deterministic and idempotent for future re-runs.

frontend/src/api/client.ts:28 rewriteMedia() walks the whole response tree, checking a MEDIA_FIELDS whitelist. Absolute HTTPS URLs are passed through unchanged; data: strings are also passed through (already-migrated data means this is now a no-op path). MEDIA_FIELDS includes 'url' which is useful for /api/sample-videos items but could inadvertently rewrite unrelated 'url' string fields in the future — currently safe because the set of endpoints returning a top-level `url` field is small and all are media.
frontend/src/api/client.ts:87 uploadMedia() explicitly wraps the response through resolveMediaUrl() so the caller receives an absolute URL — good.
server.py:1487 SAMPLE_VIDEOS is now 6 (down from 9 in iter-12). Test contract adjusted to `len == 6` as per this iteration's spec. If the array grows again, update the test.
seed_data_creation: One OTP phone user +911234567892 ('IT13 Charlie'). One small JPEG (~1 KB) uploaded to /app/backend/media/ per test run — harmless orphan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run serially: `pytest backend/tests/test_iter13_media_migration.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=`. Export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env before invoking (pytest does not auto-load frontend/.env). The migration is idempotent — re-running dedup_base64_media.py is safe. If future work re-introduces base64 storage, this test suite will catch it. Note that /api/media/* is served via app.mount() (not the api router) — GETting a filename that doesn't exist returns 404 with default StaticFiles behavior; not currently tested.
